text:
alex: Hey -- about to open my first PR here to tweak a log line. Quick q: branch naming convention and preferred reviewers for a tiny infra-adjacent change?

maya: Use `fix/TKT-<num>-short` or `feature/...` if it changes behavior. Keep it concise.

alex: And squash vs merge?

maya: Squash for single-file fixes. Keep merge commits for multi-component work.

olivia: PR body should have a 1-line summary, before/after, and test steps. If it touches CI or deploys tag @eng-infra.

alex: Pre-commit failed locally: ```black...Failed
isort...Failed```

maya: run `pre-commit run --all-files` or `make format`. If black fixes applied but commit still blocks: `git add -A && git commit --amend --no-edit`.

ci-bot: CI queued for commit 0a1b2c -> https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/1300 :rocket:

alex: Docs-only changes -- single reviewer ok?

maya: Yes docs-only can be a single reviewer and mark label `docs`.

olivia: Quick checklist: branch name, short summary, run pre-commit + tests, add tests or manual steps, tag code-owners, changelog if user-facing, keep PR small (<500 LOC).

alex: Cool, pushing now. Will ping if I need a quick pair review @maya :thumbsup:
